provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Column-vector expectation n(t+1)=A*n(t) with fixed nonnegative projection matrix. Entries combine stipulated survival, stage transitions and recruitment per census step; no density dependence, migration or environmental variation. This is a controlled mean-projection model, not a stochastic extinction calculation.
target: Evaluate every listed whole-population expected census, including step0, with one common initial vector. Choose the earliest step if totals tie within1e-10. The dominant eigenvalue is the asymptotic expected per-step factor and does not impose immediate stable stage composition.
scope: Finite-window transients and asymptotic expectation are different questions; finite counts and dominant eigenvalues are not persistence probabilities.
